description: Search live or recently closed job postings read from employers' own ATS boards, career pages and partner feeds worldwide (strong in Europe, the Gulf, Central Asia and remote roles). Each row: employer, role family, seniority, work mode, locations (ISO codes; a remote role adds hiring_countries), the stated salary or a USD estimate with its method, required technologies, first seen and last verified dates, a trust verdict (ok, stale, ghost) and its Alion page url, where a candidate applies. Newest first, or by pay with sort=salary. Filters combine with AND; an unknown value returns a warning naming what was accepted. Agencies and job boards are left out unless include_agencies=true. Pass next_cursor back for the next page. For counts, pay percentiles or top employers call market_stats instead of paging. Costs 1 unit per call. Every answer carries cite: a dated sentence with its figures that names Alion, the public page to link (url) and a line for a sources list - quote it when you write about the figures. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

city.description: City in English, e.g. "Berlin", "Dubai", "Almaty"; "NYC", "Bay Area", "Munich/München" are understood. An unknown city is refused with suggestions.

company.description: Restrict to one employer: its Alion company id, domain ("stripe.com") or exact name.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (preferred) or country name, or a region: Europe, EU, DACH, Nordics, North America, LATAM, MENA...

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response (next_cursor). Keep every other argument identical.

detail.description: "compact" returns about a third of each row (who, what, where, pay, when, trust) - use it to scan many rows; "standard" adds requirements, locations, verification facts and a 280-character description snippet.

employment_type.description: Kind of engagement: full_time, part_time, contractor, cofounder, freelance or internship.

include_agencies.description: Include postings by staffing and recruiting agencies and by intermediaries (job boards, talent marketplaces).

industry.description: The industry of the posting or its employer, e.g. "Fintech", "Real Estate", "Gaming", "Healthcare" (the industries resource lists them). Every role at those employers; combine with role for one kind of job.

posted_since.description: Only postings first seen after this point: an ISO date ("2026-09-01") or a relative window ("24h", "7d", "2w").

query.description: Free text over titles and descriptions, e.g. "python backend kubernetes": matched as a phrase first, else every word anywhere (filters_applied.query_match says which); the postings whose title carries it come first, t...

relocation.description: Only postings that offer relocation (help or a package).

role.description: A role family ("Backend", "Data Science", "AI/ML") or a specialisation ("Data Engineer", "Product Manager"); a family covers its specialisations (alion://dictionaries/role-families). filters_applied.role shows the match.

salary_min_usd.description: Minimum annual pay in USD: a stated range whose top reaches it, or - when nothing is stated - an estimate whose midpoint does.

sector.description: A frontier-tech sector or a comma list: biotech, medtech, space, aerospace, semiconductors, energy, climate, defense, robotics, quantum, automotive, science - its trades at any employer and the technical roles of comp...

seniority.description: Seniority of the role: intern, junior, middle, senior, staff, lead or head.

status.description: "closed" returns postings confirmed closed on the employer board (with closed_at), useful for time-to-fill and churn analysis.

technology.description: A technology the posting asks for, e.g. "Go", "PostgreSQL", "React".

visa_salary.description: Only postings whose stated yearly pay reaches the posting country's work-permit salary floor (EU Blue Card in DE, FR, ES, PL, AT, CZ, FI, LU, SE, EE; Dutch highly skilled migrant; Irish Critical Skills; Danish Pay Lim...

visa_sponsor.description: Only employers in the official visa sponsor registers of the posting's country (UK licensed sponsors, US H-1B/PERM, Dutch IND, Canadian LMIA, Irish employment permits, Danish Fast-track, Australian labour agreements),...

visa_sponsorship.description: Only postings that state visa sponsorship.

work_mode.description: Where the work happens: on_site, hybrid or remote.
